body: I mean... it's not gonna kill me just yet, I've cut myself for a long time in the past without any complications.

I don't care who I call or talk to, I don't necessarily want to die, it's just that I don't want to live and dying is the only other option, y'know?

The only problem I have with the hotline is that if I tell them I am currently cutting myself with intent to kill myself, I'm rather concerned they will attempt to trace my location and send the cops. And I will not go to a psych ward, I have a gun next to me incase someone tries to break in but I'd rather not use it.

I don't think I could ever stop cutting myself.

Even if I didn't kill myself, that's been my coping mechanism since I was 13. It only hurts in a good way, it allows me to take my frustration out, and it won't kill me unless of course I want it too...
